title: How a Godly Man Handles a Best Friend Who's Drifting
caption:
Your best friend is pulling back from God, and from you. You can lecture him, ignore it, or do the slower thing.

Four moves for this week: name what you actually see, show up before you speak up, say the hard thing once, and stay when it gets awkward.

Who comes to mind? Text him tonight.
